hotel.name: The St. Regis Al Mouj Muscat Resort

verified_facts.text: The resort stretches along a 360-meter beachfront in Muscat, Oman.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stretching along a 360-meter beachfront, The St. Regis Al Mouj Muscat Resort graces the shores of the Sultanate of Oman

verified_facts.text: The resort is in Al Mouj, near the marina, the airport, the opera house and the islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: this Muscat resort offers a prime location in Al Mouj near the marina, airport, opera house, and islands

verified_facts.text: The Al Mouj Golf Course, designed by Greg Norman, is a few steps from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just a few steps away from our resort, the award-winning Al Mouj Golf Course, designed by golfing legend Greg Norman

verified_facts.text: The Al Mouj Golf Course is a par-72 championship course stretching along a six-kilometer coastline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stretching along a six-kilometer coastline, this par-72 championship course offers lush green fairways, challenging bunkers, and natural dunes.

verified_facts.text: The Guerlain Spa has wet facilities with steam rooms and saunas.
verified_facts.excerpt: wet facilities featuring steam rooms and saunas

verified_facts.text: The Guerlain Spa offers a wellness menu inspired by Omani philosophy and spirits.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guerlain Spa presents a bespoke wellness menu inspired by Omani philosophy and spirits

verified_facts.text: The beachfront Guerlain Spa offers hammam therapy and a scent bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guerlain Spa is a tranquil beachfront spa in Muscat our guests can enjoy, with 11 treatment rooms, VIP suites, hammam therapy, an exquisite scent bar

verified_facts.text: Karibu serves breakfast and dinner, blending Omani specialties with influences from Zanzibar to India, inspired by the spice route.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the historic spice route, Karibu creates a captivating setting for breakfast and dinner, blending Omani specialties with influences from Zanzibar to India.

verified_facts.text: At Zorba, Chef Thanos recreates his grandmother's recipes from the Greek Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chef Thanos infuses each dish with passion and authenticity, recreating his grandmother's cherished recipes from the Greek Islands.

verified_facts.text: Dining venues at the resort include COYA, Em Sherif and Hakkasan.
verified_facts.excerpt: thirteen distinctive dining venues such as COYA, Em Sherif, and Hakkasan

verified_facts.text: The Stage is a bar and cigar lounge for adults 21 and over.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Stage is a sophisticated bar and cigar lounge in Muscat for adults 21+.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a rooftop padel court for all skill levels.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rooftop padel court provides a vibrant and engaging environment for all skill levels

verified_facts.text: Watersports at the resort include paddleboarding, kayaking and snorkeling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover an array of watersports at our resort, including paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling.

verified_facts.text: Sunset cruises, diving and dolphin-watching are available on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Additional activities are available upon request, such as sunset cruises along Muscat

verified_facts.text: The Adventure Hub kids club has a games and TV area, an art and craft corner, a reading corner and a kids pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our facility features a Games & TV area, Art & Craft Corner, Reading Corner, and a Kids Pool, ensuring endless fun and creativity.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are inspired by luxury yachts and nautical themes.
verified_facts.excerpt: each thoughtfully inspired by the elegance of luxury yachts and nautical themes

verified_facts.text: The duplex suites have fully equipped kitchens, dining areas, walk-in wardrobes and balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each suite features fully-equipped kitchens, dining areas, walk-in wardrobes, elegant bathrooms, and spacious balconies.

verified_facts.text: The duplex suites include a private deck with a plunge pool and direct access to the resort pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxurious amenities include a private deck complete with plunge pool and direct access to the resort

verified_facts.text: The Royal Suite has a private infinity pool and two jacuzzis.
verified_facts.excerpt: This stunning suite offers a private infinity pool and two jacuzzis

verified_facts.text: St. Regis butlers are available around the clock.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our butlers are available around the clock to ensure your experience is seamless and memorable.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea at The Lounge draws inspiration from the parties once hosted by Caroline Astor.
verified_facts.excerpt: drawing inspiration from the lavish parties once hosted by Caroline Astor. At The Lounge, in the heart of the resort

verified_facts.text: Muscat International Airport is approximately 8.1 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: MCT is located approximately 8.1 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Al Mouj Muscat Resort.
